## Validation

- [ ] `npm run smoke:http`

## Safety

- [ ] No real tokens, private domains, memo content dumps, `.env`, SQLite DBs, or local caches are committed.
- [ ] New write tools are gated and documented.
- [ ] README/docs are updated when behavior or config changed.
